run_doctest_suite: run all doctest examples of the polars module and report failures via unittest
build_filtered_test_suite: build a filtered test suite that skips doctests for optional modules like jax and torch
create_ignore_result_checker: create a custom doctest output checker that supports an IGNORE_RESULT directive
test_modules_in_path: test all python modules in a source directory path by dynamically importing them
summarize_doctest_teardown: summarize the doctest teardown function that restores polars config defaults between tests
